violations.text: (Beans) was observed held at (45) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

(Chips ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the (basement ) area. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (stove hoods, prep shelves, and grill table ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (basement) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025
The ceiling in the (basement 3 bay sink ) area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025

Working containers of (dry ingredients) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025
Inspector observed tortillas, cilantro, and bread covered with linen and/or nin food grade bags.PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025

The ice machine is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment, items, and clutter were observed in the (basement) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2025

Raw animal foods (eggs, pork) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (limes, avocados) in the refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/04/2024

Chicken was observed held at 110 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. New Violation. Correct By: 01/04/2024
Observed single service to be stored on the floor in the basement. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/04/2024
The faucet to the 3 bay sink is leaking. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/12/2024

The floors in the back kitchen are constructed of wood which is not durable, easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. The materials for indoor floors must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2024
